messages:
marin-docs: Heads up from today's onboarding session  the quickstart README in `quickstarts/basic-chat` has a couple of copy/paste drifts that are causing confusion.

kai-eng: What did you see?

marin-docs: Two small but impactful ones: the curl example hits `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` while the SDK examples use `/v1/chat` (different routes). Also the curl uses `Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_API_KEY` but our SDKs and API expect `Bearer`. Folks are copy/pasting and getting 401/404 combos.

zoe-ux: Oof, route + auth mismatch. That explains the "why is my sample returning HTML 404" tickets. Any other drift?

pat-se: I noticed README's Python snippet uses `client = Client(api_key)` but current Python SDK is `Client.from_api_key(os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))`. Small constructor shape drift means workshop examples fail for new users.

marin-docs: Exact bad curl block currently in README:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"hey"}'
```

pat-se: Suggested fix: (1) change endpoint to `/v1/chat`, (2) header to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (3) include side-by-side minimal examples for curl, JS, and Python with correct ctor shapes. Also add a single-line Troubleshooting: "401 -> check Authorization header (Bearer) and env var name".

kai-eng: I'll open a tiny PR with those changes + a one-line GitHub Actions smoke job that starts a mocked server and runs the curl example against it. That will catch regressions if copy/paste drifts in future.

zoe-ux: Can we also add a short note in the README about "What this quickstart is not"  clarify retry behavior so people don't assume automatic infinite retries. Maybe: "SDKs provide limited automatic retries for transient errors; configure retry/backoff for production via SDK options."

marin-docs: Yes please. Also request: include before/after snippet in the PR description to speed review.

pat-se: I'll also add a tiny comment in the Go example: show explicit `WithAPIKey` option and link to the SDK reference so folks don't try older ctor shapes.

ci-bot: PR opened by kai-eng: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/pull/212  actions: smoke-test + lint started. :white_check_mark:

marin-docs: Thanks! After merge I'll update the quickstart index and the onboarding checklist so support can close the related tickets. This should reduce first-day friction. :tada:
